title: Danish Government Scholarship at the University of Copenhagen
provider: University of Copenhagen (UCPH), funded by the Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science
funding_type: Full or partial tuition fee waiver and/or monthly living expense grant
application_deadline: January 15 (September semester intake); September 1 (February semester intake). For the 2027/2028 cycle: January 15, 2027 (September intake).
application_opening_date: October (coincides with the master's admission application opening)
eligibility_summary: Must be a citizen of a country outside the EU, EMEA and Switzerland; admitted to a full-time master's degree programme at UCPH; granted a time-limited residence permit for study in Denmark. Applicants with a legal claim to Danish citizen rights or eligibility for Danish State Educational Grant (SU) are excluded.
funding_details: Awarded on academic merit only (no separate application). Coverage varies by faculty: tuition waiver (full or partial) and/or an amount covering basic living expenses. Living expense grants are taxed per Danish tax legislation (some nationalities exempt - notified in award letter). Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences and Faculty of Science offer tuition + living expenses (~22 months); Faculty of Social Sciences offers 2-3 awards per year (tuition + living); Faculty of Theology offers partial tuition waivers only.
duration: Full duration of the master's programme (typically 2 academic years). Living expense grants cover up to 22 months for some faculties.
status: upcoming (2027/2028 September intake applications open October 2026; February 2027 intake deadline September 1, 2026 has passed)

title: Danish State Scholarship at Aarhus University
provider: Aarhus University (AU), funded by the Danish state
funding_type: Tuition fee waiver (full or partial) and/or monthly living expense grant
application_deadline: January 15 (summer/September intake); September 15 (winter/February intake). For 2027/2028 cycle: January 15, 2027.
application_opening_date: With the master's admission application (no separate application window announced)
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA citizens applying for a full-time master's degree at Aarhus University who are liable to pay tuition fees. EU/EEA/Swiss students are not eligible. Applicants are automatically considered based on academic merit during admission - no separate application form or additional documents required.
funding_details: Funding type varies by faculty: Faculty of Arts and Aarhus BSS offer tuition fee waiver plus monthly living grant; Faculty of Natural Sciences and Faculty of Technical Sciences offer tuition fee waiver only. Only 1-2 scholarships per master's programme typically awarded. Selection based solely on academic achievement (GPA minimum 98% for Faculty of Science in 2025). Tuition-only waiver recipients may need to document self-support for residence permit.
duration: Full duration of the master's degree programme
status: upcoming (2027/2028 September intake - applications open late 2026; winter/February 2027 intake deadline September 15, 2026 is approaching)

title: Tuition Fee Waiver for International MSc Students at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU)
funding_type: Full tuition fee waiver (100% tuition coverage; no monthly stipend)
application_deadline: January 15 (annually, for Autumn intake). For 2027 intake: January 15, 2027.
application_opening_date: September-October 2026 (coincides with the admission application cycle)
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students applying for a full-time MSc programme at DTU. Must apply by the January 15 deadline and submit a separate personal statement focusing on Bachelor's-level academic achievements. Applicants with Danish qualifying degrees must also apply by January 15. Not available for Spring intake.
funding_details: Full tuition fee waiver covering the two-year MSc programme cost. No monthly living stipend is provided. Awarded based on academic excellence as part of parallel admissions-process assessment. Not available for Spring semester intake.
duration: 2 years (full tuition coverage for the standard MSc duration)
status: upcoming (2027 Autumn intake - application deadline January 15, 2027; applications open September-October 2026)

title: Danish Government Scholarship at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
provider: University of Southern Denmark (SDU), funded by the Danish government
funding_type: Full tuition fee waiver and/or monthly living stipend (fully funded)
application_deadline: Master's: February 1 (annually). Bachelor's: March 15 (with uniTEST). For 2027 intake: Master's February 1, 2027.
application_opening_date: With the admission application (no separate application window; automatic consideration upon admission application)
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA citizens enrolling in specific programmes at SDU's Sonderborg (MSc) or Vejle (BSc) campuses. Must be admitted to: MSc in Engineering - Electronics/Electrical Engineering, MSc in Engineering - Mechanical Engineering, or MSc in Engineering - Mechatronics (Sonderborg); or BSc in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Interactive Technology Engineering, or Software Engineering (Vejle). Students eligible for Danish State Grant (SU) are excluded.
funding_details: Full tuition fee waiver covering 30 ECTS per semester for the full programme duration (2 years for MSc, 3 years for BSc). Stipend rate for new students in 2026 was DKK 11,225 (~EUR 1,503) per month, subject to Danish tax (some exemptions apply). Scholarship retention requires satisfactory academic progress (>= 30 ECTS per semester).
duration: 2 years for MSc programmes; 3 years for BSc programmes
status: upcoming (2027 intake - Master's application deadline February 1, 2027; applications open with admission cycle)

title: International Student Scholarship at Aalborg University (AAU)
provider: Aalborg University (AAU), funded by the Danish government
funding_type: Full funding - 100% tuition fee waiver plus monthly living stipend (fully funded)
application_deadline: March 1 (autumn/September intake); October 15 (spring/February intake). For 2027 intake: October 15, 2026 (spring) or March 1, 2027 (autumn).
application_opening_date: September-October (autumn intake); July-August (spring intake), coinciding with admission application
eligibility_summary: International (non-EU/EEA) students entering Aalborg University as full-degree master's students. Must apply for admission to one of AAU's English-taught master's programmes. Automatic consideration - no separate scholarship application required. Limited to approximately 15 recipients per year.
funding_details: 100% tuition fee waiver plus a monthly stipend of DKK 9,960 (~EUR 1,330) for the entire duration of the programme. Stipend is subject to Danish tax (some nationalities may be exempt). The stipend may not cover all living expenses in Denmark and students are advised to have supplementary savings.
status: open (spring 2027 intake - application deadline October 15, 2026 is approaching) / upcoming (autumn 2027 intake - application deadline March 1, 2027)
